role: Displays a scrollable panel of MUI Chips for recognized objects/faces from camera feed
detail: RecognitionChips is a React FC that subscribes to recognizedItems from the app store and renders them as styled MUI Chips. For each item, it determines coloring based on two flags: discovered (unknown vs known) and type (face vs object). Unknown items get orange/amber colors with a pulse animation (2s ease-in-out infinite); known faces get cyan, known objects get green. Duration > 5000ms is appended as suffix (format: 60s -> 1m, etc.). Unknown items pulse between opacity 1.0 and 0.6. The panel has a fixed header with Eye icon and 'RECOGNIZED' label, scrollable content area with flex-wrap, and renders 'Nothing detected yet' when empty.
